appDesc.message: AI-powered bilingual translation — shows original and translated text side by side, with YouTube subtitle support

noConnection.message: Cannot reach page — please refresh and try again

ytCaptionUnavailableHint.message: Try turning on YouTube CC, then check again. If the video has no captions, speech recognition is needed to create them.

ytDownloadHint.message: Original above translation, using the same sentences and translations as playback. Untranslated sections are translated first; long videos may take a while.

ytDownloadPartialHint.message: Only live captions are available. The download covers recorded viewing only, excluding unwatched sections.

ytDownloadNoData.message: No caption data yet. Start bilingual subtitles and play part of the video, then retry.

ytDownloadInvalidData.message: Caption timing is invalid. Refresh the page and retry.

ytDownloadCancelled.message: The video or translation settings changed. Download again.

ytDownloadPartialComplete.message: Download of recorded viewing started. Unwatched sections are excluded.

ytTranslationTimeout.message: Translation request timed out. Please retry.

ytTranslationIncomplete.message: The model returned incomplete translations. Please retry.
